snippet.title: City Stations Creator Pack | Trailer | Cities: Skylines II
snippet.description:
City Stations will be available on the 18th of March!

The brand new Creator Pack City Stations by Bad Peanut expands your transport toolkit with compact depots, detailed rail yards, alternate station designs, and new landmarks that fit neatly into growing cities. 

Pair that with Smooth Vibes FM and Skyrail Radio, and your citizens will have the perfect soundtrack for their daily commute.

Available here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3579770
